note: What each boss does in battle, in our words, plus Invokers that counter it. Keyed by boss id from data/bosses.json. pick.why is either 'both' (has both of the boss's corruption tolerances, checked by the boss-abilities test) or an effect the Invoker brings (checked against its skill text).

abilities.name: Cloud Splitter
abilities.text: Hits the 2 furthest Invokers with an 8s Daze that purges 2 buffs, then leaps and launches everyone near the target for 4s, draining 35% Ultimate Mana.

abilities.name: Ogryn Fury
abilities.text: Hits the whole arena and adds a Blight stack to everyone.

abilities.name: Ancestral Wards
abilities.text: Summons 2 Heal Totems (1% of his max HP every 1.5s) and a Bone Totem that adds Blight every 3s. Kill the Bone Totem first.

abilities.name: Warchant
abilities.text: At 66% and 33% HP he channels, invincible, while 4 Power Totems heal him up to 12.5% each over 30s. He then gains +1.68% ATK per 1% healed. Break the totems and bring Heal Reduction.

DungeonRelics2.passive: Gains 10s of Invincibility every time a Bleed lands on him. Never bring Bleed.

abilities.name: Shadefall
abilities.text: Hits everyone and adds a Fatigue stack per hit (0.5% max HP every 10s, -2% Move SPD each).

abilities.name: Realmbreak
abilities.text: Two launches, the second throwing targets 10m for 3s. Move SPD gets you back in.

abilities.name: Necrocall
abilities.text: Summons alternating waves of Undead (up to 2 Minibosses and 10 Minions) and casts a 7s Crush.

abilities.name: Lifereap
abilities.text: Teleports to your furthest Invoker, pushes them 11m and casts a 15s Crush. Keep the team together.

abilities.name: Deadraise
abilities.text: Revives every minion and heals them to full with double ATK. Its cooldown doubles each use, so Block Revive and Hex win the race.

DungeonRelics6.passive: Gains 3 random buffs every 20s (all 5 in Demon form). Burn and Bleed hurt him half as much and shorten his cooldowns. Mindworm stops it.

abilities.name: Lost Sword
abilities.text: Three hits on one Invoker: 20% RES Down, 20% ACC Down, 5% Skill Recovery Down. Cleanses 2 of his debuffs.

abilities.name: Demon Vein
abilities.text: One of three arena strips erupts after 5s (two in Demon form) and adds Bloodrot. Move out.

abilities.name: Stolen Wings
abilities.text: Charges your highest-HP% Invoker, steals a buff from each target and casts an 8s Manashock. In Demon form he also heals 2.5% max HP a second for 4s.

abilities.name: Demon form
abilities.text: At 0 HP he returns fully healed. Black Reach hits everyone with 20% ATK Down, 10% Crit Rate Down and a heavier Bloodrot, and his combo drains Titan Mana.

ClanBoss1.passive: +20% DEF per buff on him and +5% ATK per debuff on your team. Mindworm doesn't stop it.

abilities.name: Combo attacks
abilities.text: Damage is a share of your max HP plus Manaburn, so DEF barely helps. The third combo heals his Crypt Rats.

abilities.name: Regal Edge
abilities.text: Three hits on one Invoker: DEF Down, Weaken and 25% Heal Reduction, while he gains DEF Up and Harden.

abilities.name: Avarice Crush
abilities.text: Hits everyone with ATK Down, Combo SPD Down, a 3s Crush and Manaburn.

abilities.name: Vermincall
abilities.text: Puts Swarm on one Invoker for 20s (can't be cleansed or shortened) with heavy slows, and summons 8 Crypt Rats, then 8 more. Clear them with AoE.

abilities.name: Immortal Thief
abilities.text: Charges the Swarmed Invoker and steals 3 buffs. Jinx keeps his buffs off; Immunity keeps your debuffs off.

DungeonTitan.passive: Takes 50% more damage from Titans and 50% less from everything else. Bind a Titan to every Invoker.

abilities.name: Hail of Voidfire
abilities.text: Falling rocks add a Burn and Mindfog, leaving fire pools for 12s.

abilities.name: Breath of Soulburn
abilities.text: A 5s sweeping breath that extends every Burn by 5s each tick. Bring Burn removal or Immunity.

abilities.name: Melody of Darkstone
abilities.text: Nightmare on everyone for 10s while stones fall and stun for 1s.

abilities.name: Roar of the Eternal
abilities.text: A big breath that summons 5 Fire Elementals.

DungeonTank.passive: Each Burn or Bleed on her cuts 1s off Ensacment. Immune to crowd control.

abilities.name: Ensacment
abilities.text: Seals one Invoker (Tanks first) for 10s, taking 10% HP a second: current HP for Tanks, max HP for everyone else. Titans die instantly. Rotate two Tanks.

abilities.name: Parasitis
abilities.text: Hits everyone twice: a 5s Crush, then Manaburn.

abilities.name: Dreadscutter
abilities.text: Tramples toward your furthest Invoker, stunning for 3s.

abilities.name: Probosis
abilities.text: Acid puddle in front of her for 6s.

abilities.name: Scudbirth
abilities.text: Shields for 30% of her max HP and lays 4 eggs that hatch in 10s. Break them first.

DungeonSupport.passive: Deals 5% less damage per buff on the target and takes 5% more per debuff on him. Stack buffs on your Tank and debuffs on him.

abilities.name: Rival
abilities.text: His first combo marks one Invoker for 15s: they deal 50% more damage to him and take 25% more from him.

abilities.name: Burning Salvo
abilities.text: Atrophy, then a rocket barrage with a Daze that purges 2 buffs. Dodge the second hit.

abilities.name: Seismic Pumps
abilities.text: Expanding rings that Daze. Dash toward him to avoid them.

abilities.name: Steel Entanglement
abilities.text: Pulls everyone in, then Dazes after 5s. Move away in time.

abilities.name: Combustive Power
abilities.text: Burns a Power Cell for +30% ATK, +10% Crit Rate and +15% Crit DMG for the rest of the fight. Kill him fast.

DungeonMelee.passive: Revives at full HP after 30s until the Heart of Ice is destroyed. Each time she falls, the Heart loses 10%.

abilities.name: Call of the Tundra
abilities.text: A 10s blizzard: 50% Move SPD Down that skips Melee Attackers, plus 2 Fatigue stacks (0.5% max HP a tick, -3% Move SPD each).

abilities.name: Winter's Fury
abilities.text: Hits your furthest Invoker with a 3s Frost that stops their cooldowns.

abilities.name: Elemental Shards
abilities.text: Hold the three shards to turn Frost Shards into Flame Shards and break the Heart.

DungeonRanged.passive: Takes 80% less damage from Bleed. Never bring Bleed.

abilities.name: Claws of the Great Cult
abilities.text: Four hits on one Invoker that grow with every ally within 5m: Manashock on the first, Blight on the last. Spread out.

abilities.name: Burn Unsacred Blood
abilities.text: Blight on everyone, then 50% ATK Down on anyone within 5m.

abilities.name: Creeping Doom
abilities.text: His lizard charges your furthest Invoker, casting Manashock on each hit.

abilities.name: Deadsun Ritual
abilities.text: A 15s channel that wipes the team unless he loses 10% max HP. It summons 4 Doomclaws across the river either way.

abilities.name: Donate the Worthy
abilities.text: Eats the Doomclaws for 5% HP each and permanent ATK and Crit. Only Ranged Attackers can reach them.

DungeonEssenceNeutral.passive: 50% chance to steal a buff with every attack. Astral, so no Invoker has element advantage or disadvantage.

abilities.name: Celestial Rage
abilities.text: Marks 3 Invokers and blasts around them, adding Atrophy (0.5% max HP every 10s, -1% RES a stack).

abilities.name: Astral Waves
abilities.text: Waves sweep the arena's three lanes one by one: 15s Crush and Atrophy. Step out of the charging lane.

abilities.name: Cosmic Dive
abilities.text: Dives at your furthest Invoker and launches everyone in the path.

abilities.name: Astral Rain
abilities.text: Shields for 30% of max HP and rains on everyone until it loses 10% max HP. Burst it down.

DungeonEssenceFire.passive: Every 15s, everyone takes 0.5% max HP as Manaburn and a 1% Burn that splashes onto nearby allies. Immune to Burn.

abilities.name: Ignic Hail
abilities.text: Marks 3 Invokers, extends all their debuffs by 5s and adds Manaburn.

abilities.name: Scorched Breath
abilities.text: Lane-by-lane flame gusts: Daze, Manaburn and 5% Crit Rate Down.

abilities.name: Searing Fury
abilities.text: Charges your furthest Invoker and launches everyone in the path.

abilities.name: Ruptured Sky
abilities.text: Shields for 30% of max HP and rains lava until it loses 10% max HP.

DungeonEssenceDark.passive: Reflects 55% of Active Skill damage back at the caster, unless it has Combo SPD Down on it.

abilities.name: Falling Eclipse
abilities.text: Marks 3 Invokers, removes a buff per hit and adds Manaburn.

abilities.name: Paths of the Penumbra
abilities.text: Lane-by-lane waves: Manaburn and Manashock, which also drains 50% Ultimate Mana.

abilities.name: Hunt of the Dark
abilities.text: Dives at your furthest Invoker and launches everyone in the path.

abilities.name: Shimmer of the Void
abilities.text: Shields for 30% of max HP and rains on everyone until it loses 10% max HP.

DungeonEssenceWind.passive: Dodges 60% of combo attacks, unless it has Move SPD Down on it.

abilities.name: Tempest Crush
abilities.text: Marks 3 Invokers, adds Fatigue and shortens every debuff on it by 5s. Keep Move SPD Down topped up.

abilities.name: Deadwind
abilities.text: Lane-by-lane waves: Nightmare and Fatigue.

abilities.name: Gustfall
abilities.text: Dives at your furthest Invoker and launches everyone in the path.

abilities.name: Nature's Embrace
abilities.text: Shields for 30% of max HP and rains on everyone until it loses 10% max HP.

DungeonEssenceWater.passive: Every 15s, everyone takes 0.5% max HP as Mindfog and 70% Move SPD Down for 10s. Her skills hit 50% harder per debuff on the target.

abilities.name: Dewburst
abilities.text: Marks 3 Invokers and adds Mindfog (-3% ACC a stack). Damage grows 50% per debuff on each target, so cleanse often.

abilities.name: Pulltide
abilities.text: Lane-by-lane tidal waves: 15s Frost, Mindfog and 5% Weaken for 20s.

abilities.name: Floodwings
abilities.text: Dives at your furthest Invoker and launches everyone in the path.

abilities.name: Eternal Downpour
abilities.text: Shields for 30% of max HP and rains on everyone until it loses 10% max HP.

DungeonEssenceEarth.passive: At 75%, 50% and 25% HP, everyone gets a 15s Paralysis, then a random skill on 30s cooldown. Immune to Bleed.

abilities.name: Torrent of Earth
abilities.text: Marks 3 Invokers and adds Bloodrot (-3% healing a stack) while it gains +35% Crit Rate. Purge or steal its buffs.

abilities.name: Gale of Stonewind
abilities.text: Lane-by-lane gales: 15s Paralysis, Bloodrot and Crit Rate Down.

abilities.name: Wings of Swiftstone
abilities.text: Dives at your furthest Invoker and launches everyone in the path.

abilities.name: Song of the Monolith
abilities.text: Shields for 30% of max HP and rains on everyone until it loses 10% max HP.

DungeonEssenceLight.passive: Whenever an Invoker heals, their max HP drops by half the amount healed, for the rest of the fight. Use shields and Invincibility, not heals.

abilities.name: Twisted Prism
abilities.text: Marks 3 Invokers and adds Blight (-3% Skill Recovery a stack).

abilities.name: Fractured Spectrum
abilities.text: Lane-by-lane light waves: 15s Paralysis and Blight.

abilities.name: Glimmerflash
abilities.text: Charges your furthest Invoker and launches everyone in the path.

abilities.name: Beams of Radiance
abilities.text: Shields for 30% of max HP and beams everyone until it loses 10% max HP.
